label: PF Backlog 47
title: Update stale pipeline docs to match the CODE (code is the source of truth)
body: REFRAIMED: the pipeline CODE is already unified/standardized/wired (one source of truth); the DOCS are stale. Code-verified corrections: tests live in products/<project>/tests/ (not test-framework/tests/<project>/); 7a/7b/7c are NOT stages (stage 6=NFR, 7=packaging); docs/pipeline-state.md has no writer (pipeline-state.json=truth, pipeline.json=derived); on_complete is decorative/unexecuted; no Prometheus /metrics (JSON telemetry only); runtime tier precedence = products/pipeline_dashboard/model-tier.json over config/model-tier.json; ops phase is an opt-in post-deploy hook (ops.enabled), not stage 13; runtime roster = agents/*.agent.json + config/model-tier.json + agent-requirements.json (not .opencode cards); port_config.update_ports_from_config and memory_api are not wired; knowledge graph is in-memory (not persisted). Deliverable: update the docs (+wire the unwired pieces) to match code.

decisions.note: [P1] Docs=code: update stale pipeline docs after code fixes land.
